scenarios.title: Shadow planner on: at the checkpoints the `planner shadow:` line names the same attack as the combat profile
scenarios.pending_reason: the scenario format asserts game state (the dump), not a line of the bot log, and the log is the only place the shadow planner writes (it changes nothing the dump can show). Needs an assertion kind that reads a bot log line (log_line with a pattern, run through the Trace) before it can run. Offline equivalent, run on every merge: internal/agency TestPlannerAgreementFixture (the planner against the combat profile at six checkpoints per shipped table, mismatches documented in testdata/agreement.json).
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 18 with the points a played level gives; the autopilot spends them from the plan table so the hero has the table's skills. Reachable by play.
scenarios.notes: Run shape once the assertion exists: wait one virtual minute after the points are spent, then expect one line `planner shadow: ... agree=true` for the Sorceress and for the Paladin whose table is not paladin-zealot-lite at clvl 18 (that checkpoint is a documented mismatch: the estimate prefers Sacrifice over Zeal). The knob is shadow only: the hero's play must equal a run with agency.planner 0, so no_writes and the same quest progress.
